text: You there...
zh: 那边的你……

text: How do you know about Dhul'oq?
zh: 你是怎么知道杜尔奥克的？

text: A being named Nuveyar told me about it.
zh: 一个名叫努维亚的存在告诉我的。

text: I saw it on a map.
zh: 我在一张地图上看到的。

text:
A being?
That's interesting.
zh:
一个存在？
有意思。

text:
There aren't many maps left showing Dhul'oq.
I assumed I had found the last one.
zh:
标有杜尔奥克的地图已所剩无几。
我本以为最后一张已经在我手里了。

text: Why did you think you would find something about Dhul'oq here?
zh: 你为什么觉得能在这里找到关于杜尔奥克的东西？

text:
Themir?
He was once a mage at my court.
zh:
塞米尔？
他曾是我宫廷里的法师。

text: Themir, a magician, said I could find something about it here.
zh: 一位叫塞米尔的魔法师说，我能在这里找到相关的东西。

text: I didn't know where else to start.
zh: 我不知道还能从哪儿查起。

text: And you immediately thought of my library, right?
zh: 于是你立刻就想到了我的图书馆，对吧？

text: Some of those books around here were collected by Themir himself.
zh: 这里有些书正是塞米尔亲自收集的。

text:
You must know that I'm searching for Dhul'oq myself.
At least, I was searching for it.
zh:
你要知道，我自己也在寻找杜尔奥克。
至少，我曾经找过。

text: But enough of Themir.
zh: 不过塞米尔的事就说到这儿。

text:
Many years ago, I had a dream, or rather a vision, of Dhul'oq.
After my research, I discovered where Dhul'oq should have been.
zh:
许多年前，我做过一个关于杜尔奥克的梦，或者说是一场幻象。
经过一番查证，我找到了杜尔奥克本该所在的位置。

text:
When I got there, all I found were ruins and an old tower.
As I didn't find what I was really looking for, I stopped searching for the time being.
zh:
可当我赶到那里，只见到废墟和一座古塔。
既然没找到我真正想找的东西，我便暂且搁下了这桩寻访。

text: It can't be a coincidence that you too are looking for Dhul'oq.
zh: 你也在寻找杜尔奥克，这绝不会是巧合。

text: I want you to go to this place and then let me know if you find anything interesting.
zh: 我要你去那个地方走一趟，若发现任何有意思的东西，就回来告诉我。

text: Where is Dhul'oq located?
zh: 杜尔奥克在哪里？

text: Why should I help you?
zh: 我为什么要帮您？

text: I will return and tell you what I find.
zh: 我会回来向您禀报我的发现。

text: I need to think about it.
zh: 我得考虑一下。

text: Cross the #:Marin Passage:# north of the capital, which leads to the Marin Cliffs.
zh: 穿过王都以北的#:马林通道:#，它通向马林悬崖。

text: Then all you have to do is follow the path west through a passage, and you will end up at a #:lake:#.
zh: 然后你只需沿小路向西，穿过一条通道，便会抵达一座#:湖:#。

text: The ruins of the city of Dhul'oq can be found there.
zh: 杜尔奥克城的废墟就在那里。

text: With this authorization, the gate to the Marin Passage will be opened for you.
zh: 凭这份通行令，马林通道的大门会为你开启。

text: Certainly, we will find an appropriate reward after your return.
zh: 当然，等你归来，我们自会给你相称的报酬。

text: I expected as much from you.
zh: 我对你正有此期望。

text: You are now allowed to reach out to me in the throne room, provided no other audience is taking place.
zh: 今后你可以到王座厅来见我，只要当时没有其他觐见在进行。

text:
Remember, I'm still the king around here.
It's better if I owe you something, rather than the other way around.
zh:
记住，这里做主的还是我这个国王。
宁可我欠你的情，也别让你欠我的。

text: Speak to me in the throne room if you decide to tell me about Dhul'oq.
zh: 若你决定告诉我杜尔奥克的消息，就到王座厅来见我。

text: Go now!
zh: 去吧！

text: With this authorization, the gate to the Marin Passage will be opened for you.
zh: 凭这份通行令，马林通道的大门会为你开启。
